outcome: Cerebral palsy (as the intended outcome of neuroprotection)
cohort: Women delivering at less than 30 weeks gestation at National Women's Health, Auckland City Hospital.
finding: Adherence to the magnesium sulphate guideline for neuroprotection was 82% (58 of 71) in eligible women and 95% (58 of 61) in women where it was clinically appropriate and practically achievable.
cross-section timing: The first year after the guideline's implementation (2012)
